title: Throat of the Hull
description: A screaming reese bass in the low register: detuned sawtooth layers beat against each other while a deep FM index and ladder-filter envelope claw the timbre open into a metallic shriek. Over 24 cycles the fm depth, vowel formant and stereo-drifting pan LFOs all travel on different clocks, so the voice slowly mutates from a growl into an alien scream and back.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 ab1 <c2 eb1>>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .detune(sine.slow(11).range(0.08, 0.4))
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(1.5, 11)).fmh("<1 0.5 1.5 2>/8")
    .vowel("<a e o u>/6")
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(180, 3400)).resonance(17).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<2 4 6>/8").lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.18)
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .shape(sine.slow(19).range(0.2, 0.55)).crush("<16 16 8 6>/16")
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.22).sustain(0.55).release(0.08)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.12, 0.88))
    .jux(rev)
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.4).pan(sine.slow(17).range(0.85, 0.15)))
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").room(0.4)
    .gain(0.82)
)
